scope: Oye campus area architectural reconstruction; boundary and building identities unverified

footprints.geometry: Mapped polygons; machine detections need checking

terrain.source: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / global terrain data courtesy of USGS
terrain.processing: Terrarium decoding, 3x3 weighted elevation smoothing for DEM/canopy noise, bilinear grid sampling, polygon foundation grading with a 35m transition and rendered triangle interpolation; no vertical exaggeration

landscape.processing: Oye window read from public cloud-optimized GeoTIFF. Class 10 drives tree placement and other classes tint terrain. Shared, spatially chunked instances, maximum 3200 trees.
landscape.limitations: 2021 satellite classification, not a current tree survey. Trees are excluded from mapped buildings and roads. No invented parking, gardens or sports sites.

textures: Locally generated canvas textures; no third-party texture assets

reference.author: 0xbigturk
reference.use: Behavior and visual layout reference. Application implementation and textures are original. No reference buildings or downloaded reference code are served.
